research_question: What is the effect of multifaceted implementation interventions compared with no implementation intervention or usual practice on adherence to evidence-based recommendations in the care of people with acute stroke during hospital admission?
control_label: Usual care or no implementation intervention
outcome_description: Proportion of eligible patients receiving recommended evidence-based acute stroke processes of care during hospital admission (primary process/adherence measure per trial)
positive_direction: Higher adherence to evidence-based acute stroke recommendations in the multifaceted intervention group compared to control (RR > 1)
search_queries: multifaceted implementation stroke guideline adherence trial
quality improvement acute stroke care pathway controlled trial
audit feedback education stroke care adherence randomized
inclusion_criteria: Randomised controlled trials (including cluster-randomised trials) evaluating multifaceted implementation interventions in acute stroke hospital care
Comparison against usual practice, standard care, or no active implementation intervention
Quantitative reporting of adherence to evidence-based clinical recommendations or acute stroke care processes during hospital admission
exclusion_criteria: Not an original empirical study (systematic reviews, meta-analyses, editorials, opinion pieces, protocol papers, and theoretical articles)

No comparison between a multifaceted implementation intervention and a usual care/no-intervention control condition (including studies comparing active implementation strategies against each other or single-component interventions)
No quantitative outcome data reporting adherence to evidence-based acute stroke processes of care (events and totals or adjusted risk ratios/odds ratios)
Studies not involving acute stroke hospital care or evaluating exclusively post-discharge, outpatient, or non-stroke populations
moderators_to_extract: Intervention components (e.g., audit and feedback, educational meetings, local champions, clinical pathways)
Targeted stroke process of care (e.g., thrombolysis administration, dysphagia screening, comprehensive stroke unit care protocol)
Study geographic region or healthcare system setting
effect_size_note: Risk ratio (RR) of adherence (intervention vs. control) pooled under a random-effects model on the log risk ratio scale. For cluster-randomised trials without reported cluster-adjusted RRs/ORs, standard errors are adjusted by the design effect using reported ICC or an assumed ICC of 0.05.
